Step:  
Kolkata (IST) = UTC+5:30.  
US/Mountain = UTC-7.  
Difference = (-7) - (5.5) = -12.5 hours.  
11:00 PM (23:00) - 12 hours 30 minutes = 10:30 AM same day?  
23:00 - 12:30 = 10:30 (previous calendar day because crossing midnight backward).  
So May 12, 1501 23:00 Kolkata → May 12, 1501 10:30 Mountain? Let's check carefully:  

23:00 - 12:30 = 10:30 on May 12. But subtracting 12.5 hours from 23:00 on May 12 actually goes back to 10:30 on May 12, not May 11. That means it's still same date in Mountain Time.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 10:30
